profile.name: Jason Luman
profile.intro: I build mobile apps and practical software, from everyday school tools to personal finance and productivity apps.
profile.description: Jason Luman is a software engineer in Jakarta building React Native apps, school systems, and practical tools for everyday work.
profile.title: Jason Luman | Mobile Software Engineer

sections.title: Personal projects
sections.intro: Two apps I built for managing finances and reusing clipboard history.

items.title: Finance Studio
items.subtitle: AI Integrated Web and mobile finance app
items.summary: Track transactions, investments, and savings goals across personal and small-business finances.

image.alt: Finance Studio overview with fictional balances and cash-flow charts
image.caption: Live demo · Fictional data

blocks.heading: One database for web and mobile
paragraphs: I built a Next.js web app and an Expo mobile app backed by a shared PostgreSQL database. Both give users a place to see the money they have, the investments they hold, and the goals they’re saving toward.

blocks.heading: Review before saving
paragraphs: I integrated the Google Gemini API to draft financial entries for users to review before saving. The public web demo runs in the browser with fictional balances and transactions.

items.title: SnipMoor
items.subtitle: Windows clipboard manager
items.summary: Save, search, and reuse clipboard entries with a global keyboard shortcut.

image.alt: SnipMoor’s compact Windows clipboard history panel with fictional example clips
image.caption: App preview · Sample clips

blocks.heading: Retrieve a clip while you work
paragraphs: I built SnipMoor to make earlier clipboard entries easy to retrieve. A global shortcut opens a compact, searchable history, and the app encrypts saved clipboard entries on the device.

blocks.heading: Desktop app and licensing
paragraphs: I built the desktop app with Tauri and Rust and used React for the interface. I developed a separate licensing service on Cloudflare.

sections.title: Career
sections.intro: I work on school apps and systems at Bina Inovasi Global, the IT division of Bina Nusantara.

items.title: Junior Software Engineer
items.subtitle: Bina Inovasi Global · Jakarta Barat, Indonesia
items.summary: I develop mobile tooling, maintain React Native releases, and contribute to school systems.

blocks.heading: School systems
paragraphs: Our team developed cross-platform school systems. I contributed to synchronizing gradebooks with the learning management system, implementing a multi-tier database approval workflow, and building mobile modules for emergency attendance and digital policy enforcement.

blocks.heading: Mobile maintenance
paragraphs: I built in-app tools to inspect network requests and app state on the device, implemented deep-link navigation, and upgraded React Native in the existing codebase to keep dependencies stable.

blocks.heading: iOS release engineering
paragraphs: I improved Azure CI/CD pipelines and upgraded the macOS build environment to meet App Store SDK requirements. I managed manual production releases using Xcode and TestFlight.

items.title: Associate Software Engineer
items.subtitle: Bina Inovasi Global · Jakarta Barat, Indonesia
items.summary: I built React Native features for BINUS SCHOOL e-Desk and school event booking.

blocks.heading: e-Desk across five schools
paragraphs: I worked with my team to build cross-platform modules for class schedules, electives, and score summaries in BINUS SCHOOL e-Desk. We rolled these modules out across five schools.

blocks.heading: Event invitations and booking
paragraphs: I implemented a centralized invitation and booking system from technical specifications. It gave parents and school staff a shared place to coordinate events and reduced manual administrative work.

blocks.heading: Dashboard and connectivity
paragraphs: I reworked dashboard interfaces to manage shared state with Redux and deployed a consistent offline dialog across the app’s modules.

sections.title: Leadership

items.title: Human Resources Department Staff
items.subtitle: Bina Nusantara Computer Club · Jakarta Barat, Indonesia
items.summary: I served on the BNCC Board of Management as Human Resources Department Staff.

blocks.heading: Talent development and member engagement
paragraphs: As an HRD Staff member, I contributed directly to talent development initiatives aimed at supporting member growth and overall engagement. I managed organizational programs that fostered a strong community environment, ensuring members were well-supported throughout their technical and professional development within the club.

items.title: Freshmen Leader & Partner
items.subtitle: First Year Program · BINUS University, Tangerang, Indonesia
items.summary: I held both Freshmen Leader and Freshmen Partner roles in the university’s First Year Program.

blocks.heading: Freshmen Leader ? Aug?Sep 2024
paragraphs: During the intensive First Year Program (FYP), I led and managed a dedicated team of incoming freshmen through their initial university orientation. I directed team-building activities, coordinated campus introductions, and guided my cohort through key milestones like the Inauguration Day events. I acted as the first point of contact to ensure new students felt welcomed, engaged, and fully prepared to start their academic careers.

blocks.heading: Freshmen Partner ? Sep 2024?Aug 2025
paragraphs: As a Freshmen Partner, I served as a primary mentor for first-year students, guiding them through their critical transition into university life. I facilitated weekly mentorship sessions throughout their first two semesters, providing actionable advice on course selection, effective study strategies, and personal development. By acting as a reliable support system, I helped new students confidently navigate their academic journey, which ultimately strengthened my own leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

items.title: Human Resources Department Activist
items.subtitle: Bina Nusantara Computer Club · Jakarta Barat, Indonesia
items.summary: I joined the BNCC Human Resources Department as a committee member.

blocks.heading: Onboarding and community
paragraphs: In my role as an HRD Activist, I supported the onboarding of new students by providing direct mentorship during their transition into campus life. I worked alongside fellow leaders to plan and deliver engaging orientation events and community workshops. I also led informational sessions, breaking down complex academic and extracurricular guidelines for incoming club members.

blocks.heading: Where I use them
paragraphs: I work with JavaScript on React Native apps, C# and SQL on school systems, and Rust on SnipMoor’s desktop app. My technical skill set also includes Python and C.

items.title: Frameworks & libraries
items.summary: Mobile, web, desktop, and backend development

blocks.heading: Where I use them
paragraphs: I use React Native CLI and Redux on school apps, and ASP.NET for school systems. I paired Next.js with Expo in Finance Studio and used Tauri with React for SnipMoor.

items.title: Databases & delivery tools

blocks.heading: Where I use them
paragraphs: I’ve worked with Azure DevOps for CI/CD and Xcode and TestFlight for iOS releases. Finance Studio shares a PostgreSQL database across web and mobile, and SnipMoor uses Cloudflare for licensing.
